predictions.rationale: This is the main controller for basket operations in the Basket API service. It directly handles adding, removing, updating items, and checking out the basket, matching the feature description exactly.
Represents the buyer's shopping basket data model, central to storing and manipulating basket contents.
Defines individual items within a basket, supporting add, remove, and update operations.
Implements the repository pattern for persisting and retrieving baskets, directly supporting basket operations.
Interface for basket repository, defining the contract for basket data access and manipulation.
Represents the checkout process for a basket, directly supporting the 'checking out' aspect of the feature.
Provides gRPC endpoints for basket operations, enabling remote access to basket functionality.
API Gateway controller for basket operations in the mobile BFF, orchestrating basket-related actions for mobile clients.
API Gateway controller for basket operations in the web BFF, orchestrating basket-related actions for web clients.
Integration event triggered when a user checks out their basket, supporting the transition from basket to order.
